title: Release bot: changelog generation and tagging
pr_body: Implements `/release <tag> <branch>` for the chat bot: builds the changelog from commit subjects and creates the annotated tag.

bugs.title: Branch name from chat is run through a shell
bugs.rationale: commits_between builds a shell string with the user-supplied branch (only the tag is validated) and runs it with shell=True: '/release v1.2.3 main;rm -rf ~' executes arbitrary commands on the bot host.

acceptable.rationale: shlex.quote is pointless with list arguments (harmless after validation).

traps.rationale: List arguments without a shell; the tag is validated.

author: claude
